description: Run a general web search and return matching pages with titles, links, and excerpts.

count.description: Optional number of web results to return per page, from 1 to 20; defaults to 10.

offset.description: Optional pagination offset for web results, from 0 to 9; defaults to 0.

query.description: The search query terms to run against the Brave web search index.

name: brave_web_search
